lead.title: Hedepy raises €4M in debt from Orbit Capital to consolidate online mental healthcare in Central Europe
lead.deck: The Prague-based online psychotherapy platform (nearly 1,200 therapists, around 300,000 sessions a year, nine European countries, more than 300 corporate clients) has raised €4M in venture debt from Orbit Capital to fund acquisitions, physical clinics and a clinical arm including psychiatry. A non-dilutive consolidator play in Europe's highly fragmented mental health market, with Czech and Slovak health insurers as the next target.

milestone.title: South London and Maudsley awards The Access Group a 10-year EPR contract estimated at £11.9M
milestone.summary: The London mental health trust selected The Access Group's electronic patient record through the NHS LPP framework, for a contract running November 2026 to November 2036 with go-live in 2027. AI will be part of the EPR, which is also meant to underpin ambient voice technology.
milestone.why: One of England's largest mental health trusts is committing for a decade: an EPR is becoming the entry ticket for AI tools (scribes, ambient voice) and a major outlet for vendors able to plug into it.

deal.thesis: Finland's Oura (around 6 million members, $533M in Q3 revenue, up 153%) is buying Counsel Health, an AI-native primary care practice with employed physicians, for cash. The ring stops being just a sensor: Counsel's AI will draw on weeks of biometric data to triage and advise, then hand off to a physician within minutes (prescriptions, labs, chronic care). Closing is expected before the end of 2026.

brefsEurope.title: DocMorris unit TeleClinic acquires Swiss telemedicine platform Medi24 from Allianz Partners
brefsEurope.summary: Medi24 (around 250 doctors, nurses and service staff) provides contractually guaranteed first-line telemedical access to more than 4.6 million insured people, roughly half of Switzerland's insured population. Enterprise value is in the low double-digit CHF million range and closing is expected in December 2026: the first step in TeleClinic's international rollout.

brefsEurope.title: G Square-backed Mayden acquires My Clinical Outcomes, a patient-reported outcomes platform
brefsEurope.summary: Founded in 2011 by a former NHS doctor, My Clinical Outcomes automates the collection and analysis of PROMs and PREMs that patients complete at home; it counts more than 200 hospitals, 3,000 clinicians and 180,000 patients. Terms were not disclosed; Mayden keeps building its platform after acquiring Ireland's Wellola.

brefsEurope.title: Barnsley Hospital NHS FT awards Lyrebird Health an ambient voice contract running to February 2028
brefsEurope.summary: The contract covers ambient voice technology (AVT) licences in acute care from November 2026 to February 2028, following a pilot in outpatients and emergency care; funding arrangements allow further rollouts. Another trust win, just as Wales' DHCW abandoned its £10M AVT procurement for lack of compliant suppliers.

brefsEurope.title: Wales rolls out a national emergency care dataset and automates ambulance delay reporting
brefsEurope.summary: The Welsh Emergency Care Data Set, a mandated national standard, has been live at Aneurin Bevan since October 1 and should cover every health board by March 2027; a new cloud-first emergency care module replaces the legacy module of the Welsh PAS, starting in Powys. Ambulance handover delay data now flows automatically, seven days a week, into the national cloud platform.

brefsEurope.title: PARA-AI project: 83% of SECAmb paramedics would use AI in clinical practice with safeguards
brefsEurope.summary: A ten-month mixed-methods study (171 responses, 14 interviews): 96% want to keep the final decision, 92% want to help design the tools and 83% worry about over-reliance. The trust is also testing a wearable voice-operated device for electronic patient record documentation in the AT PACE project (50 participants in simulation).

brefsEurope.title: MEDICA 2026: dEEGtal Insights, Precisia Care and RegCheck among seven Swiss start-ups at the Start-up Park
brefsEurope.summary: At the Swiss pavilion of the Düsseldorf trade fair (November 16-19), three of the seven start-ups are pure software: dEEGtal Insights (AI that interprets EEG signals for epilepsy diagnosis), Precisia Care (predictive analytics on patient data) and RegCheck (AI compliance platform for manufacturers and certification bodies).

brefsIntl.title: XRHealth acquires PursueCare and picks up RESET and RESET-O, the digital therapeutics inherited from Pear
brefsIntl.summary: The immersive virtual care platform acquires PursueCare's addiction telehealth clinics and its two FDA-authorized prescription digital therapeutics (substance use and opioid use disorders). Terms were not disclosed: Pear's flagship DTx assets change hands again, a sign of consolidation in the category.

brefsIntl.title: Zus Health, founded by former athenahealth chief Jonathan Bush, raises a $33M Series B led by Drive Capital
brefsIntl.summary: Sanofi Ventures, HealthX Ventures and Alumni Ventures join a16z, F-Prime and Maverick; total funding now exceeds $100M. Zus aggregates patient data from multiple sources into a unified record and uses AI to generate source-linked chart summaries for risk adjustment and quality measures.

brefsIntl.title: Google Cloud previews Gemini for Healthcare, an agent orchestration layer for health systems and payers
brefsIntl.summary: Pre-configured skills (longitudinal chart synthesis, pre-visit chart prep, medical necessity review) and around 25 connectors, including Epic, Oracle Health, InterSystems, BMJ Digital Health and Suki. A US-only preview: hyperscalers are positioning themselves as the agentic layer above the EHR, with direct stakes for the European start-ups that plug into it.

word.definition: Standardised, validated questionnaires in which patients rate their own health, symptoms and quality of life before and after care, to measure what a treatment actually changed for them.

parts.label: Dashboard and alerts
parts.role: the feedback loop to the care team and registries

how.t: The patient fills in a generic quality-of-life questionnaire and a disease-specific one, on a hospital tablet or their own device.
The platform prompts the patient at set intervals after care; in oncology, weekly questionnaires can trigger an alert to the team when a significant symptom appears.
Scores are compared before and after treatment, across patients and across providers, and feed registries and national quality programmes.

word.why: PROMs are the measurement layer of value-based care: the NHS has collected them since 2009, Germany's Federal Joint Committee (G-BA) has recommended rolling them out in routine hip and knee replacement care, and in France oncology remote monitoring based on patient-reported symptoms is on the LATM list. Platforms that industrialise collection and EHR integration are becoming consolidation targets, as Mayden's acquisition of My Clinical Outcomes, reported on November 10, shows.

startups.name: Heartbeat Medical
startups.use: CE-marked PROMs platform; won the hospital-wide rollout at Charité (up to 800,000 patients a year)

startups.name: Amplitude Clinical Outcomes
startups.use: Electronic PROMs collection for NHS hospitals and orthopaedic registries, with automated registry uploads

startups.name: Resilience Care
startups.use: Resilience PRO, a Class IIa software medical device for remote monitoring of symptoms reported by cancer patients, in the RC-102 randomised trial
